'''Game News & Updates''' in ''[[The Duelist]]'' #19 (October 1997, page 78) is an Inside the Industry news column by [[Allen Varney]]. Its Star Wars CCG item names [[Cloud City Limited|Cloud City]].<ref name="duelist19news" />

[[File:Duelist 19 page 78.jpg|thumb|right|260px|The Duelist #19, October 1997, page 78.]]

The SWCCG item sits among other Decipher and licensed-game notices on the same page.

<blockquote>
'''Star Wars CCG''' (Decipher): ''Cloud City'', due in September, will cover the final third of ''The Empire Strikes Back''. Players can put a price on an enemy character's head and send bounty hunters to collect it. The 180-card set (fifty common, fifty uncommon, and eighty R1 rare) sells in nine-card boosters ($2.50). &lt;<nowiki>www.decipher.com</nowiki>&gt;
</blockquote>
